theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_positive_density_cover_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (W : ℕ → Set (Eucl P)) (S : Set (Eucl P)), (∀ q, IsOpen (W q)) → (∀ q, ν (W q) < ∞) → S ⊆ ⋃ q, W q → (∀ x ∈ S, 0 < dimensionalUpperDensity ν.toOuterMeasure (n : ℝ) univ x) → (∃ C : ℕ → Set (Eucl P), S ⊆ ⋃ i, C i ∧ ∀ i, (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (C i) < ∞) ∧ (ν S = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) S = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
